name: Real Mahjong Adventure Umi e ~Summer Waltz~
original_name: リアル麻雀アドベンチャー海へ~Summer Waltz~
source:
This spin-off title in the Super Real Mahjong series takes a much different approach. It's a visual novel. You can pursue a relationship with several girls from Super Real Mahjong PV, P VI, and P7. There is a lot of talking, and you often have to make choices of what to say or do. An overworld map system is utilized, as the girls are in different locations.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sega-saturn/real-mahjong-adventure-umi-e-summer-waltz]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
这款《超级真实麻将》系列的衍生游戏采用了截然不同的方法。这是一部视觉小说。你可以与《超级真实麻将PV》、《P VI》和《P7》中的几位女孩建立关系。有很多话，你常常必须选择说什么或做什么。由于女孩们位于不同的位置，因此使用了全球地图系统。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sega-saturn/real-mahjong-adventure-umi-e-summer-waltz]Moby Games[/url]]
